text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: KV-cache surge detected in rope-serving cluster r-17. Memory + eviction spikes, continuous-batch queue backlog. Affected models: longrope-yaRN (ntk-enabled). Errors rising -> 503s for inference behind loadbalancer. Pager severity: P1. Root TS: 2133337770
oncall_olivia: Picking this up. Live graphs? link: https://r-console/graphs/kv/r-17 :eyes:
sre_miguel: seeing host mem at 94%, eviction rate 3.2k/s, cache size +150% over baseline. Top keys: sliding_window prefixes for longctx sessions. Also continuous-batch backlog length 1200 -> latency climb.
eng_runtime_lee: likely regression from yesterday's continuous-batching change (auto-window growth for NTK). Quick hypothesis: prefetch + sliding-window growth caused kv card explosion.
eng_ml_sara: confirm: new NTK rollouts allow window up to 4096 and YaRN prefetch is enabled for longrope models. Combined with many parallel sessions this will blow up KV cardinality.
oncall_olivia: initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch on longrope models (disable YaRN prefetch), 2) reduce continuous-batch window cap to 1024 -> 512, 3) bump eviction aggressiveness and TTLs. Who can push configs?
eng_runtime_lee: I can push hotpatch to runtime config. Will prepare a quick patch to disable prefetch and lower window cap. Command I will run:```bash
redwoodctl config set --scope cluster:r-17 --key runtime.prefetch.yaRN.enabled --value false
redwoodctl config set --scope cluster:r-17 --key runtime.batch.window_max --value 512
```
prod_support_tim: Noted customer impact: several customers on EU region reporting 5xxs and slow responses. CS queue showing ~12 tickets now, highest impact on enterprise customers with long-context workflows.
cs_anya: contacting top-affected accounts, letting them know we're mitigating; ETA 15m for first fix.
sre_miguel: rolling metrics look noisy but starting to drop after partial config applied to a canary set (r-17-a). Eviction rate down to 800/s on canary, mem down ~8%. Still high on remainder.
oncall_olivia: Lee, execute hotpatch targeting canary then roll. Please include graceful drain to avoid head-of-line blocking.
eng_runtime_lee: running canary now. Applying:```bash
# canary
redwoodctl rollout --cluster r-17 --pool r-17-a --patch-file - <<'PATCH'
{ "runtime": { "prefetch": { "yaRN": { "enabled": false } }, "batch": { "window_max": 512 } } }
PATCH
```
eng_runtime_lee: canary applied. Monitoring.
sre_miguel: canary mem -> 78%, eviction 420/s, request latency back to baseline. Good signal. Starting staged roll to remaining pools with 2-min pause between pools.
prod_support_tim: in-flight customer update posted to status page: "We are mitigating elevated error rates for long-context requests in EU. A fix is being rolled out; some requests may be delayed. Updates every 15 minutes." :writing_hand:
eng_ml_sara: long-term we need guardrails: cap ntk window growth when prefetch is enabled and tie prefetch budgets to per-customer session count. Filed a follow-up: ENG-1298.
oncall_olivia: roll is 4/6 pools done. Observability: KV key-cardinality graph still trending down. Any regression in throughput?
sre_miguel: throughput slightly lower due to smaller window but latency/SLOs improved. Customers with short prompts unaffected.
eng_runtime_lee: final pools patched at 2133338080. Running extra eviction pass:```bash
redwoodctl tools kv-evict --cluster r-17 --policy aggressive --confirm
```
eng_runtime_lee: eviction pass completed; mem stable 66%. Continuous-batch queue < 50.
cs_anya: triage complete for impacted customers, CS will follow up with individual mitigation notes. No data loss reported.
prod_support_tim: tally: ~18 customer sessions impacted intermittently, 3 enterprise customers saw degraded throughput for ~12-20 minutes. Recording timeline for postmortem.
oncall_olivia: Handoff to daytime oncall @sre_miguel in 10m. Miguel please take lead and own follow-ups, embed steps: revert if unexpected, ensure canary monitors for 12h.
sre_miguel: ack. I will keep the incident channel open and prepare impact summary + timeline. Also recommend a short-term policy: auto-disable prefetch for any model with session concurrency > 100 until we implement budgeted prefetch.
eng_ml_sara: I will add regression tests for NTK + YaRN prefetch combos and add performance guard in CI.
eng_runtime_lee: put a hotfix PR to baseline config so this doesn't re-enable on next deploy: https://git/internal/pr/54321 :thumbsup:
prod_support_tim: updating status page: major mitigation completed, customers may see residual latency. Follow-up postmortem requested.
oncall_olivia: incident summary draft: "Root cause: interaction between NTK window growth + YaRN prefetch increased KV cardinality leading to eviction storms and elevated 5xxs. Mitigation: disabled YaRN prefetch, reduced window cap to 512, applied aggressive eviction, rolled config across pools. Customer impact: intermittent 5xxs for long-context requests affecting ~18 sessions and 3 enterprise customers for 12-20m. Next steps: guardrails, CI tests, config defaults. Owner: sre_miguel + eng_ml_sara."
sre_miguel: I'll produce postmortem and schedule a 1hr blameless review tomorrow. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:"
